title: String extraction and locale-aware formatting from day one, translations deferred
context: application-spa-REQ-015 requires internationalisation readiness without shipping translations. The mechanism needs one recorded answer inside the SPA.
decision: User-facing strings live in an extraction catalogue keyed by stable identifiers; components render through the catalogue lookup. Dates, numbers, and currency format through the platform locale APIs (Intl). Layout is authored with logical properties (inline-start over left) so RTL rendering survives without a parallel stylesheet.
consequences: Localisation later is catalogue work, not surgery. The discipline costs a lookup per string and forbids concatenated sentence fragments, which also improves copy review.
